## Purpose 

CL 1.11
SF 1.2.1
Previously, we used nested iterations to solve for the snow surface temp using a flux balance. The outer iterations were carried out using secant method, the inner with whatever SF uses. In principle a single location not converging will lead to 8 iterations (max_iter = 8) of the secant method everywhere, each of which calls surface fluxes, itself an iterative solve with 7 iterations.

This PR changes the snow model to use the surface flux option of updating the temperature and humidity at the surface using functions provided by us. It uses a newton update to update T_sfc each SF iterations.

I also changed the initial guess to be the current T_sfc instead of T_atmos; this requires initializing the field the first step (otherwise we would pass it p.snow.T_sfc as a guess, but this has not been set to anything yet). I did this by making/changing methods of set_initial_cache for Snow/integrated models with Snow
